Resolute Technique
fields.FlavourText: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.

fields.Name: Giant's Blood
fields.FlavourText: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.

fields.Name: Unwavering Stance
fields.FlavourText:
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.

fields.Name: Avatar of Fire
fields.FlavourText: "In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."

fields.Name: Blood Magic
fields.FlavourText: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.

fields.Name: Zealot's Oath
fields.FlavourText: Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.

fields.Name: Ancestral Bond
fields.FlavourText:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

fields.Name: Pain Attunement
fields.FlavourText:
Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.

fields.Name: Chaos Inoculation
fields.FlavourText: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.

fields.Name: Eldritch Battery
fields.FlavourText:
What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?

fields.Name: Mind Over Matter
fields.FlavourText: While the mind endures, so too will the body.

fields.Name: Whispers of Doom
fields.FlavourText: Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.

fields.Name: Necromantic Talisman
fields.FlavourText: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.

fields.Name: Conduit
fields.FlavourText: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!

fields.Name: [UNUSED] Ghost Reaver
fields.FlavourText: I will wear your ghost, and you will die twice: against me, and for me.

fields.Name: Resonance
fields.FlavourText: The notes may change, but the song remains the same.

fields.Name: Eternal Youth
fields.FlavourText: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.

fields.Name: Primal Hunger
fields.FlavourText: The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.

fields.Name: Dance with Death
fields.FlavourText: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.

fields.Name: Heartstopper
fields.FlavourText: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.

fields.Name: Oasis
fields.FlavourText: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.

fields.Name: Vaal Pact
fields.FlavourText:
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.

fields.Name: Iron Reflexes
fields.FlavourText: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?

fields.Name: Glancing Blows
fields.FlavourText: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.

fields.Name: Elemental Equilibrium
fields.FlavourText: Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.

fields.Name: Bulwark
fields.FlavourText: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.

fields.Name: Crimson Assault
fields.FlavourText: Each nick and cut brings death one step closer.

fields.Name: Trusted Kinship
fields.FlavourText: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.

fields.Name: Hollow Palm Technique
fields.FlavourText: The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.

fields.Name: Blackflame Covenant
fields.FlavourText:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.

fields.Name: Ritual Cadence
fields.FlavourText: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.

fields.Name: Chimeral Blood
fields.FlavourText: All animals share common ancestors. You carry them within you still.

fields.Name: Scarred Faith
fields.FlavourText: Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.

fields.Name: Lord of the Wilds
fields.FlavourText: Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.

fields.Name: Wildsurge Incantation
fields.FlavourText:
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...

Energy Shield if Consumed Power Charge

Barya of Navira
fields.FlavourText:
"You knew the twisted plan these fools devised. As Tale-woman, you are their compass in the sandstorm. Yet... you did not act. And now we mourn these honoured dead. You must pay."
 
Varashta condemned Navira to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.

fields.Name: Barya of Kelari
fields.FlavourText:
"And you... there was no excuse for your actions. You defiled them! You have tainted the very sands with the blood of your own! Yet the war rages on. You have achieved nothing. You must pay." 

Varashta condemned Kelari to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.

fields.Name: Barya of Ruzhan
fields.FlavourText:
"You have forsaken your duty to my <i>{akhara}. Yes... we do not abide weakness. But we also do not abide madness in the fervour of battle! Your slain <i>{dekhara} will have their justice. You must pay." 

Varashta condemned Ruzhan to the ritual of the <i>{barya}, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.

fields.Name: Navira's Fracturing
fields.FlavourText:
"My heart was fractured. I believed Kelari's words. I knew not his true nature... his ambition. I convinced Ruzhan there were cowards among his ranks. I failed you. And I accept my fate." 

Navira confessed her failure to Varashta.

fields.Name: Navira's Well
fields.FlavourText:
"Wipe the tears from your face, dear Navira. I did not deceive you. I meant every word. I will forever cherish you, my beloved. Know that I did it all for you... for our future!" 

Kelari pleaded with the Tale-woman.

fields.Name: Navira's Oasis
fields.FlavourText:
"Kelari, you deceiver! I fell for your words, but no longer. Your sentence is a fate too good for you! I would give anything to bring back those who fell to your lies. Instead... I mourn my choices." 

Navira lambasted Kelari a final time.

fields.Name: Kelari's Deception
fields.FlavourText:
"Listen not to his simpering words. He means to languish before you to weaken your resolve! He is duplicitous. An assassin, thriving on deception and lies. His lust for power is what drove his choice!" 

Outrage trembled in Ruzhan's voice at the sentencing.

fields.Name: Kelari's Judgment
fields.FlavourText:
"Knowing where and when to plunge your knife is more important than the sharpness of your blade. I will not forget my error... and I will be a living example of your wisdom, dear <i>{Sekhema}." 

Kelari accepted Varashta's sentence and committed himself to her.

fields.Name: Kelari's Malediction
fields.FlavourText:
"The snare was set on our fallen. Beetles burst from their flesh, flooding the sands. Their exploding carapaces halted the advancing enemy... but it was not enough. And for that... I grieve." 

Kelari admitted his wrongdoing to Varashta.

fields.Name: Ruzhan's Trap
fields.FlavourText:
"I have seen countless battles. I know war! The taste of defeat... The taste of victory! But in this war... everything is at stake. So yes, those you speak of will know my blade. I will do whatever I must!" 

Ruzhan confided in his Tale-woman, Navira.

fields.Name: Ruzhan's Reckoning
fields.FlavourText:
"I stand before you, as your humble servant. Though I was betrayed, I would do it all again, if it would have saved us. But I accept your sentence. I will atone. I pledge myself to you... forevermore." 

Ruzhan accepted his fate at the <i>{barya} ritual site.

fields.Name: Ruzhan's Fury
fields.FlavourText:
"Yes... they fell by my blade and fire lashed them for their betrayal! No <i>{dekhara} is exempt from fighting back the Winter before us, lest they too know the Doom of the Desert!" 

Ruzhan fumed at Varashta, in pure defiance.

fields.Name: Corrupted Infusion
fields.FlavourText: We seek to cleanse Corruption, not intensify it, but there may be merit to a paradoxical strategy.

fields.Name: Unstable Energies
fields.FlavourText: Overcharge the machine at your own risk.

fields.Name: Ecological Shift
fields.FlavourText: Everything changes in the wake of Corruption.

fields.Name: Tear Open the Rift: Major Breach
Tear Open the Rift: Minor Breach
Is that the best you've got?!
You can't just wake up from this one.
These demons are all your own...
Is this about me... or you?
I see your true nature now!
Are you sure you want to do that?
